The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Network Session ASIM filtering parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dstportnumber:int=int(null),
    hostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    dvcaction:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string="*",
    disabled:bool=false,
    pack:bool=false) {
    CrowdStrike_Network_Events_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0
    | where event_simpleName in (
        "NetworkConnectIP4", "NetworkConnectIP6",
        "NetworkReceiveAcceptIP4", "NetworkReceiveAcceptIP6",
        "NetworkListenIP4", "NetworkListenIP6",
        "NetworkCloseIP4", "NetworkCloseIP6",
        "RawBindIP4", "RawBindIP6",
        "FirewallRuleIP4Matched", "FirewallRuleIP6Matched")
    | extend
        _LocalIp = iff(event_simpleName contains "IP6",
            coalesce(LocalAddressIP6, LocalAddressIP4),
            coalesce(LocalAddressIP4, LocalAddressIP6)),
        _RemoteIp = iff(event_simpleName contains "IP6",
            coalesce(RemoteAddressIP6, RemoteAddressIP4),
            coalesce(RemoteAddressIP4, RemoteAddressIP6)),
        NetworkDirection = case(
            event_simpleName startswith "NetworkReceiveAccept", "Inbound",
            event_simpleName startswith "NetworkConnect", "Outbound",
            event_simpleName startswith "NetworkListen", "Listen",
            ConnectionDirection == "0", "Outbound",
            ConnectionDirection == "1", "Inbound",
            "Unknown"),
        _Action = tolower(coalesce(FirewallAction, RuleAction))
    | extend
        _IsInbound = NetworkDirection == "Inbound",
        _IsLocalSource = NetworkDirection in ("Outbound", "Listen"),
        DvcAction = case(
            _Action in ("allow", "allowed", "permit", "permitted"), "Allow",
            _Action in ("block", "blocked", "deny", "denied"), "Deny",
            _Action in ("drop", "dropped"), "Drop",
            _Action == "reset", "Reset",
            "")
    | where array_length(dvcaction) == 0 or DvcAction in~ (dvcaction)
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = case(_IsInbound, _RemoteIp, _IsLocalSource, _LocalIp, ""),
        DstIpAddr = case(_IsInbound, _LocalIp, _IsLocalSource, _RemoteIp, ""),
        DstPortNumber = case(_IsInbound, toint(LocalPort), _IsLocalSource, toint(RemotePort), int(null)),
        EventResult = iff(
            DvcAction in ("Deny", "Drop", "Reset")
                or (isnotempty(TcpConnectErrorCode) and tolong(TcpConnectErrorCode) != 0),
            "Failure", "Success")
    | where (isnull(dstportnumber) or DstPortNumber == dstportnumber)
        and (eventresult == "*" or EventResult =~ eventresult)
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(dstipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, dstipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | extend
        _SrcMatch = array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) > 0
            and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix),
        _DstMatch = array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) > 0
            and has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or _SrcMatch or _DstMatch
    | extend
        _Mac = replace_string(tolower(PhysicalAddress), "-", ":"),
        _UsernameType = case(
            isempty(UserName), "",
            UserName contains "\\", "Windows",
            UserName contains "@", "UPN",
            "Simple")
    | extend DvcMacAddr = iff(strlen(_Mac) == 12,
        strcat(substring(_Mac, 0, 2), ":", substring(_Mac, 2, 2), ":",
            substring(_Mac, 4, 2), ":", substring(_Mac, 6, 2), ":",
            substring(_Mac, 8, 2), ":", substring(_Mac, 10, 2)),
        _Mac)
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalType = event_simpleName,
        EventOriginalSubType = name,
        EventOriginalUid = CrowdStrikeId,
        DvcId = aid,
        DvcScopeId = cid,
        DvcInterface = InterfaceAlias,
        NetworkRuleName = HbfwRuleId
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp), TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventType = "EndpointNetworkSession",
        EventSubType = case(
            EventOriginalType startswith "NetworkClose", "End",
            EventOriginalType startswith "NetworkConnect"
                or EventOriginalType startswith "NetworkReceiveAccept"
                or EventOriginalType startswith "NetworkListen"
                or EventOriginalType startswith "RawBind", "Start",
            ""),
        EventOriginalResultDetails = TcpConnectErrorCode,
        EventSchema = "NetworkSession",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventVendor = "CrowdStrike",
        EventProduct = "Falcon Data Replicator",
        EventUid = EventOriginalUid,
        DvcIpAddr = coalesce(_LocalIp, aip),
        DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        DvcOs = case(event_platform == "Win", "Windows",
            event_platform == "Lin", "Linux", event_platform == "Mac", "macOS", event_platform),
        DvcOriginalAction = coalesce(FirewallAction, RuleAction),
        DvcInboundInterface = iff(_IsInbound, DvcInterface, ""),
        DvcOutboundInterface = iff(_IsLocalSource, DvcInterface, ""),
        NetworkProtocol = case(
            Protocol == "1", "ICMP", Protocol == "6", "TCP",
            Protocol == "17", "UDP", Protocol == "47", "GRE",
            Protocol == "50", "ESP", Protocol == "51", "AH",
            Protocol == "58" or Protocol =~ "IPv6-ICMP", "IPv6-ICMP",
            Protocol == "132", "SCTP",
            toupper(Protocol) in ("ICMP", "TCP", "UDP", "GRE", "ESP", "AH", "SCTP"),
                toupper(Protocol),
            ""),
        NetworkProtocolVersion = iff(EventOriginalType contains "IP6", "IPv6", "IPv4"),
        NetworkIcmpCode = toint(IcmpCode),
        NetworkIcmpType = IcmpType,
        SrcPortNumber = case(_IsInbound, toint(RemotePort), _IsLocalSource, toint(LocalPort), int(null)),
        SrcDvcId = iff(_IsLocalSource, DvcId, ""),
        DstDvcId = iff(_IsInbound, DvcId, ""),
        SrcDvcScopeId = iff(_IsLocalSource, DvcScopeId, ""),
        DstDvcScopeId = iff(_IsInbound, DvcScopeId, ""),
        SrcInterfaceName = iff(_IsLocalSource, DvcInterface, ""),
        DstInterfaceName = iff(_IsInbound, DvcInterface, ""),
        SrcMacAddr = iff(_IsLocalSource, DvcMacAddr, ""),
        DstMacAddr = iff(_IsInbound, DvcMacAddr, ""),
        SrcUsername = iff(_IsLocalSource, UserName, ""),
        DstUsername = iff(_IsInbound, UserName, ""),
        SrcUsernameType = iff(_IsLocalSource, _UsernameType, ""),
        DstUsernameType = iff(_IsInbound, _UsernameType, ""),
        SrcProcessName = iff(_IsLocalSource, ImageFileName, ""),
        DstProcessName = iff(_IsInbound, ImageFileName, ""),
        SrcAppId = iff(_IsLocalSource, ContextProcessId, ""),
        DstAppId = iff(_IsInbound, ContextProcessId, ""),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        DstSystemEntityKey = "",
        SrcApplicationEntityKey = "",
        DstApplicationEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserEntityKey = "",
        DstUserEntityKey = "",
        SrcUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        DstUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        ASimMatchingIpAddr = case(_SrcMatch and _DstMatch, "Both",
            _SrcMatch, "SrcIpAddr", _DstMatch, "DstIpAddr", "-"),
        ASimMatchingHostname = "-",
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack,
            bag_pack(
                "SourceAdditionalFields", AdditionalFields,
                "TenantId", column_ifexists("TenantId", ""),
                "_ResourceId", column_ifexists("_ResourceId", ""),
                "timestamp", timestamp, "aip", aip, "UserName", UserName,
                "ContextTimeStamp", ContextTimeStamp, "ConfigBuild", ConfigBuild,
                "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash, "ContextProcessId", ContextProcessId,
                "ContextThreadId", ContextThreadId, "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount,
                "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration, "Entitlements", Entitlements,
                "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass,
                "OciContainerId", OciContainerId, "TreeId", TreeId,
                "ConnectionDirection", ConnectionDirection, "Protocol", Protocol,
                "RemoteAddressString", RemoteAddressString, "FirewallAction", FirewallAction,
                "NegateLocalAddress", NegateLocalAddress, "NegateRemoteAddress", NegateRemoteAddress,
                "LocalAddressIP4", LocalAddressIP4, "LocalAddressIP6", LocalAddressIP6,
                "RemoteAddressIP4", RemoteAddressIP4, "RemoteAddressIP6", RemoteAddressIP6,
                "LocalAddressMaskIP4", LocalAddressMaskIP4, "LocalAddressMaskIP6", LocalAddressMaskIP6,
                "RemoteAddressMaskIP4", RemoteAddressMaskIP4, "RemoteAddressMaskIP6", RemoteAddressMaskIP6,
                "LocalPort", LocalPort, "RemotePort", RemotePort,
                "PhysicalAddress", PhysicalAddress, "ConnectionFlags", ConnectionFlags,
                "InContext", InContext, "EventOrigin", EventOrigin,
                "InterfaceIndex", InterfaceIndex, "NetLuidIndex", NetLuidIndex,
                "NeighborList", NeighborList, "NegateInterface", NegateInterface,
                "IsUnique", IsUnique, "LocalPortRangeStart", LocalPortRangeStart,
                "LocalPortRangeOperation", LocalPortRangeOperation,
                "RemotePortRangeStart", RemotePortRangeStart,
                "RemotePortRangeOperation", RemotePortRangeOperation,
                "NetworkProfile", NetworkProfile, "PolicyIdentifier", PolicyIdentifier,
                "HbfwRuleFlags", HbfwRuleFlags, "ImageFileName", ImageFileName,
                "CommandLine", CommandLine, "RuleAction", RuleAction,
                "RuleMatchCount", RuleMatchCount,
                "RuleMatchCountSinceLastReport", RuleMatchCountSinceLastReport),
            dynamic({}))
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == "Failure", "Low", "Informational"),
        EventResultDetails = iff(EventResult == "Failure", "Unknown", "NA"),
        Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, DvcIpAddr, "-"),
        SrcDvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(SrcDvcId), "Other", ""),
        DstDvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DstDvcId), "Other", ""),
        SrcAppType = iff(isnotempty(SrcAppId), "Process", ""),
        DstAppType = iff(isnotempty(DstAppId), "Process", ""),
        Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcDvcId),
        Dst = coalesce(DstIpAddr, DstDvcId),
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Rule = NetworkRuleName,
        Process = DstProcessName,
        User = DstUsername
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type,
        EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventType, EventSubType,
        EventResult, EventResultDetails, EventOriginalResultDetails, EventSeverity,
        EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventUid,
        EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalType, EventOriginalSubType,
        Dvc, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcIpAddr, DvcMacAddr, DvcScopeId, DvcOs,
        DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction, DvcInterface, DvcInboundInterface, DvcOutboundInterface,
        NetworkDirection, NetworkProtocol, NetworkProtocolVersion,
        NetworkIcmpCode, NetworkIcmpType, NetworkRuleName,
        Src, Dst, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcPortNumber, DstPortNumber,
        SrcDvcId, DstDvcId, SrcDvcIdType, DstDvcIdType, SrcDvcScopeId, DstDvcScopeId,
        SrcInterfaceName, DstInterfaceName, SrcMacAddr, DstMacAddr,
        SrcUsername, DstUsername, SrcUsernameType, DstUsernameType,
        SrcProcessName, DstProcessName, SrcAppId, DstAppId, SrcAppType, DstAppType,
        Rule, Process, User, ASimMatchingIpAddr, ASimMatchingHostname,
        DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey, DstSystemEntityKey,
        SrcApplicationEntityKey, DstApplicationEntityKey, SrcUserEntityKey, DstUserEntityKey,
        SrcUserAdditionalIds, DstUserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    dstipaddr_has_any_prefix=dstipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix, dstportnumber=dstportnumber,
    hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any, dvcaction=dvcaction,
    eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
